mr_title: Optimized RoutePattern by using string operations for converter-less routes.

expected_issues.title: String fast path breaks lazily translated routes
expected_issues.description:
The new string fast path passes self._route to str.startswith()/removeprefix(), which fails for lazily translated routes (gettext_lazy), so i18n URL patterns without converters no longer resolve.

Routes can be lazy translation proxies (path(_('about/'), ...)). The previous implementation compiled a regex from str(route) at match time. `str.startswith()` and `removeprefix()` require a real str and raise TypeError for a lazy proxy, and `self._route == path` compares a proxy. The route must be coerced with str() at match time to keep translation-aware routing.
